questionText:
Mohan and Shyam are partners in a firm. Which statement among the
below can be claimed valid if the Partnership Agreement is silent regarding
the same.

options.text:
Shyam had advanced a loan to the firm. He claims interest of @ 10% per
annum.

options.text: Shyam wants interest on capital to be credited @ 6% per annum.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Mohan is an active partner. He wants a salary of Rs. 10,000 per year.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text:
Mohan contributed Rs. 20,000 and Shyam Rs. 50,000 as capital. Mohan
wants an equal share in profits.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Accounting for Partnership (Provisions in the Absence of Partnership Deed):
Mohan contributed Rs. 20,000 and Shyam Rs. 50,000 as capital. Mohan
wants an equal share in profits.

Detailed Context:
Detailed Solution:

Mohan contributed Rs. 20,000 and Shyam Rs. 50,000 as capital. Mohan
wants an equal share in profits.

Detailed Analysis:
1. Option A: No partner is entitled to salary without deed agreement. Invalid.
2. Option B: Interest on partner loan is statutory @ 6% p.a., not 10%. 

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.
